cgu.title: Terms and Conditions of Use
cgu.section1Content1: Our web application allows users to voluntarily submit photographs of their moles to obtain an estimate of malignancy risk, generated by an artificial intelligence algorithm.
cgu.section1Content2: This service aims to raise user awareness of dermatological vigilance. It is not a medical diagnosis.
cgu.section2Content1: User: any person using the service.
cgu.section2Content2: Service: mole analysis by AI via our platform.
cgu.section2Content3: Result: non-medical algorithmic estimate provided to the user.
cgu.section3Content: The service is intended for adults or minors with parental authorization. Any commercial use is strictly prohibited. The user guarantees that the images submitted are authentic and that they own the rights to them.
cgu.section4Content: The results provided are statistical evaluations generated by an AI model. No guarantee is given as to their accuracy or medical relevance. In case of doubt, immediately contact a healthcare professional.
cgu.section5Content: All content (code, text, images, algorithms) is the exclusive property of the application publisher. Any reproduction or distribution without authorization is prohibited.
cgu.section6Content: We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or terminate the service at any time. No compensation can be claimed in case of interruption or modification.
cgu.section7Content: The publisher declines all responsibility related to the use of the results provided. Decisions made based on the estimates are the sole responsibility of the user.
cgu.section8Content: These terms may be modified at any time. It is the user's responsibility to regularly consult this page. Using the service implies acceptance of the current CGU.
cgu.section9Content: These terms are governed by French law. In case of dispute, the competent courts will be those of the publisher's headquarters.
cgu.section10Content: For any request related to the CGU, please contact: contact@dermia.com
